task.title: Pin workloads to dedicated nodes using taints plus node affinity
task.shortdesc: Combine taints/tolerations with node affinity to ensure only intended workloads can land on dedicated nodes.

step.cmd: Taint dedicated nodes with a key/value/effect (for example, "dedicated=payments:NoSchedule").
Add a matching toleration to only the workloads allowed on those dedicated nodes.
Add required node affinity for the same dedicated label so tolerated pods also target the intended nodes.
Deploy the workload and confirm it schedules onto dedicated nodes while other workloads remain excluded.
Test enforcement by deploying a pod without the toleration and verifying it stays unschedulable on dedicated nodes.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
